description: This source file contains the implementation of the RemindersTableManager class, which manages reminder entries stored in Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting reminder entries, as well as internal utility methods and data structures related to reminder management in an Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: ReminderTableEntry
classes.description: Represents a reminder entry stored in Azure Table Storage, with properties defining reminder details and methods for constructing keys and bounds used in queries.

classes.name: RemindersTableManager
classes.description: Manages reminder entries within Azure Table Storage, providing methods to find, insert, update, and delete reminders, employing partitioning and range queries for efficient data operations.

methods.name: FindReminderEntries
methods.description: Finds reminder entries within a specified range of partition key numeric values, handling wrap-around cases.

methods.name: FindReminderEntries (overload)
methods.description: Finds reminder entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: FindReminderEntry
methods.description: Finds a specific reminder entry for a given grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in the Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: DeleteReminderEntryConditionally
methods.description: Deletes a reminder entry if the ETag matches, ensuring conditional deletion.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all reminder entries associated with the configured service and deployment IDs, grouping by grain hash to optimize partitioned deletions.
